title: bn254-gt-dlp: (6,2) STNFS, run gate, log phase at its modeled expectation, survivor recheck (x16), multilevel descent evidence: 2^90.676917358

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x with g^x=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64) 2^92.033185433 < 2^90.676917358 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP, H5 and H-RC (proof.md section 9; H-RC: at most 16 times the modeled number of sieve survivors pass the exact recheck of DESCENT.md). A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7205138768842753059, the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.998486 >= 0.39, where 0.998486 is the modeled opened-run success (1 - 0.000004274 - 0.001509021 >= 0.998486); a closed run is a failure costing 1 unit. In an opened run both individual logarithms run under one combined hard phase meter of 2^106 units that aborts as failure, an every-run cap distinct from the score; the ledger charges the logarithm phase at its modeled expectation 2^88.164008 (the descent recurrence, H5), so the work bound as well as the success bound depends on the descent model, with no allowance on the work side; modeled opened-run success 0.998486. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=multilevel prints MULTILEVEL.md's tables and recomputes their limits, reading rules and the bridge; part=toy (plan,rkind,side,bits,seed) regenerates one multilevel run from its seed; the default run makes these checks and one stored-run replay. These are toy-scale measurements; transfer to production sizes is H5. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim. part=plan prints the current 62-row plan row by row (method, windows, radius, mu, psi, phi, retry, work) with the node budget, E[N] and the abort/repeat losses. part=recheck (side,parent,config,seed): survivor-law counts on one fresh production ball (DESCENT.md); part=plan adds each sieve row's instruction split.
